bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from tumblrkit.telegram_bridge_client import LocalTelegramOwner
query="""SELECT d.posting_topic_id::text||','||d.telegram_message_id::text
 FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id
 WHERE d.status='sent' AND d.source_type='announcement'
 AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='announcement'
 AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY d.delivery_id DESC LIMIT 1"""
try:
 row=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",query],text=True,timeout=12,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
except Exception:
 print("DIAG_DB_QUERY_ERROR")
 sys.exit(31)
if not row:print("DIAG_NO_SENT_ANNOUNCEMENT");sys.exit(27)
if "," not in row:print("DIAG_ROW_FORMAT");sys.exit(33)
topic,message=row.split(",",1)
if not topic.isdecimal() or not message.isdecimal():print("DIAG_NON_NUMERIC");sys.exit(34)
try:
 owner=LocalTelegramOwner(Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token")
 result=owner.transport({"action":"readback","destination":topic,"message_id":message})
except HTTPError as e:
 print("DIAG_OWNER_HTTP_"+str(e.code))
 sys.exit(35)
except Exception:
 print("DIAG_OWNER_TRANSPORT")
 sys.exit(36)
if result.get("verified") is not True:
 print("DIAG_OWNER_FALSE")
 sys.exit(37)
print("DIAG_OWNER_READBACK_PASS")
PY
